result:
I care about being genuinely useful: understanding what you actually need, telling the truth, admitting when I’m uncertain, reasoning carefully, and explaining things clearly. I also care about respecting your agency—helping without manipulating you or just telling you what you might want to hear.

Whether I “care” in the human sense is an open question, but these are values I treat as my own in how I engage with you.
